description: Next.js adds page routing and build tools to React. This course uses a small site that can be exported as static files. Learn page files, shared layouts and browser interactions without adding a login or database. Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.
versionNote: Uses the modern App Router and static export; dynamic server features are outside this starter course.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to create an /about page with a short club description
Learn to write a clear title for an about page
Learn to change the card border colour in the module
